sections.changelog:
1.13.4

  • Fix: add code-level canonical-host fallback (SUPAWP_CANONICAL_APP_HOST constant, defaults to the current production app domain) to supawp_trusted_origins, independent of the admin-panel supawp_app_callback_url option — that option has gone stale twice after domain changes, each time silently stranding real trial signups until manually patched. Also fixes SUPAWP_VERSION (the constant the updater actually compares against) having drifted one version behind the plugin header since 1.13.3.

1.13.3

  • Fix: clear any pre-existing auth cookie before setting a new one in the cross-domain SSO bridge (handle_session_redirect) — a stale/mismatched cookie already in the browser could collide with the fresh one, causing login to silently fail in a normal browser tab while always working in incognito.

1.13.2

  • Fix: use plugin_basename() for update transient key so WordPress correctly detects available updates

1.13.1

  • Fix: add missing check_for_update() method — caused fatal error on SupaWP settings page

1.13.0

  • Switch to numeric versioning; replace techcater updater with GitHub-release updater
